title: The Stop hook owner-feedback-inbox accepts a ruling filed on the roadmap branch as a home
why: Lane runner-repos-in-parallel, 13:09 CST Nov 13: its Stop hook wanted R67 and the draft-PR grant in main's docs/decisions, .claude/rules or CLAUDE.md, but rulings live on the roadmap branch, which never merges to main.
note: Todo, a possible false alarm (check the guard's record first). A lane that carries an owner grant from a roadmap ruling (drain-first-hold, lane-draft-pr-grant-owner) cannot satisfy the hook with a main home; the hook keeps asking, so the lane files a page item instead. Fix to consider: the hook accepts a ruling id found in roadmap/rulings/ on origin/roadmap as a home. Related, not the same: outbox-ruling-home-check (reads whether a ruling's main home holds its words). Measure first: how often the hook fires on a roadmap-only ruling (unmeasured).
